title: Agentic object detection
reading: The slide introduces agentic object detection, illustrated by two natural-language prompts that ask a system to find objects specified by attributes rather than a fixed class label: unripe strawberries in a picture, and airplanes with two engines. The vendor LandingAI is credited as the source of the example.

concepts.name: Agentic object detection
concepts.why_it_matters: Shifts detection from fixed label sets to open-ended, attribute-conditioned natural-language queries handled by an agentic system.

concepts.name: LandingAI
concepts.why_it_matters: Company whose product demonstrates the capability.
